notes: Sales plan per period (ST_SALES_PLAN + ST_SALES_PLAN_DET): period / store / sales type from the legacy lists, lines need an active item, quantity and price (retail price by default) (APP_RULES3_SA). The legacy form also used area / branch columns that do not exist in this database (see ST_SALES_PLAN.md) Wave 3b: legacy store / sales-type / item lists.

row_rules.ST_SALES_PLAN_DET:
-- legacy line: active item with a basic unit, retail price by default, quantity and price required
app_rules3_sa.plan_det_row(:new.item_code, :new.qty, :new.price);

validations.name: خطة المبيعات: الفترة والمستودع وحركة المبيعات

ST_SALES_PLAN.STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and stop_flag = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_SALES_PLAN.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 2 and trns_type = 2 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_SALES_PLAN_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it, st_item_unit iu where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and it.item_group_code = iu.group_code and it.item_code = iu.item_code and nvl(iu.basic_unit, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2
